Sam W: FYI opening a short rebuild runway for base-image:v2026-03. Found a chain-of-deps CVE that affects glibc -> we need a coordinated rebuild + signer RBAC change + audit-log retention tweak. proposing Tue 05:00 UTC cutover. :hourglass:
Alex R: +1. Can you list the RBAC changes you need? also we should confirm cosign key access model (KMS vs local) before the cutover.
Sam W: Good q. Minimal plan: 1) create a temporary CI signer principal 'ci-image-signer' in k8s-svc-accounts and bind to projects/images-signers role; 2) restrict long-term human keys; 3) grant audit-only view to sec-devs. I'll paste the iam binding we want shortly.
Maria (runtime): Are we planning to change image tags or keep same tags and re-sign layers? Need to know so runtime routing can pin canaries.
Jess - infra: Prefer re-sign with same tags if we can guarantee immutability, but given the CVE we may want a -rev1 tag to avoid cache confusion. Either way, infra needs the staging bucket + canary cluster names.
Sam W: OK decision: use -rev1 tag for all rebuilt images. That avoids accidental serving old image from registries with weak immutability. Canaries: staging-canary and perf-canary clusters.
Alex R: RBAC snippet (proposal):
```
# grant signer SA cosign/attach perms
kubectl create rolebinding ci-image-signer-binding \
  --role=projects/images-signers \
  --serviceaccount=ci/ci-image-signer -n images
```
We also need to add a policy that the signer SA's keys are wrapped by customer KMS and rotated by infra every 30d.
Elaine S: Audit logging: we need to enable the "image-signing" audit category in the central log sink for 90 days at minimum for compliance. Current retention is 30d.
Sam W: Correct. I'll open a support ticket to bump retention to 90d for that category and add a log filter for cosign events.
Maria (runtime): For runtime: we'll add temporary routing rule to prefer -rev1 on canaries only, then slow rollout to prod after validation. Also will enable KV-cache warmup to avoid cold-start latency.
Jess - infra: Can someone run a dry-run of the cosign signing flow? I'm thinking steps: build -> push -rev1 -> cosign sign --key kms://projects/our-kms/keys/cosign -> upload SBOM -> trigger canary deploy.
Sam W: Here's an example command for the dry-run (please test in CI staging):
```
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/our-kms/keys/cosign-key \
  gcr.io/redwood/base-image:v2026-03-rev1
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy: staging-canary at 2026-03-11T05:30:00Z (automated), perf-canary at 2026-03-11T06:00:00Z
Alex R: Quick checklist for RBAC/KMS/audit pre-cutover:
- [ ] Create ci-image-signer SA + rolebinding (Jess)
- [ ] Provision KMS key with crypto-usage 'SIGN' and rotation policy (infra)
- [ ] Update audit sink retention & filters (Elaine)
- [ ] CI pipeline step to cosign with KMS (sam/maria)
- [ ] Post-cutover vuln-scan sweep and canary validation (runtime + sec)
Jess - infra: I'll do the SA and KMS provisioning today. tagging you @Sam W for the CI step details.
Sam W: thanks. Also note: during the rebuild we will run a targeted acceptance test suite (image-sanity, vuln-scan, startup-boot) and a quick performance baseline (p95 latency) against perf-canary.
Elaine S: one compliance note: please include the build provenance (SBOM + signed manifest) in the audit event payload. That's a hard requirement for the regulator.
Maria (runtime): Understood. CI will emit SBOM JSON and attach manifest annotation: `redwood.build.provenance`.
Alex R: If any step needs emergency rollback, policy is: 1) revoke signer SA immediately, 2) block image-pull of -rev1 tag via registry ACL, 3) rollback routing to previous tag. Keep me in loop.
Sam W: I'll own rollback runbook and make it available in the incident channel. Anyone see objections to Tue 05:00 UTC cutover? :eyes:
Jess - infra: no objections from infra. :+1:
Elaine S: fine from compliance side. :white_check_mark:
Maria (runtime): fine. I'll prepare canary dashboards and smoke checks.
Alex R: OK locking it in. I'll add a short note to sec-runbook and watch the canaries during the window.
Sam W: thanks all — I'll open the PR for RBAC and the ticket for audit retention now. I'll post links here when done.
deploy-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/r/image-rebuilds/merge_requests/42
Sam W: PR and ticket links: MR 42 (rbac + pipeline changes), TKT-8731 (audit retention). Starting implementation. Ping me for inspections. :rocket:
